title: ESPN is expected to change its NFL "B" team

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: ESPN is expected to change its NFL "B" team
sources.description: With the NFL pulling the plug on the Monday Night Football doubleheaders and with ESPN slated to televise games beyond Monday night, ESPN will be making changes to its current NFL "B" team.
